object_types.definition: A source-bound observation read directly from an admitted point-in-time record.
object_types.clock_rule: available_at must not be later than the consuming decision_at.
object_types.unknown_semantics: Missing, silent, gapped or unverified input is UNKNOWN, never zero.

object_types.definition: A deterministic, versioned function of eligible facts.
object_types.clock_rule: Every input must belong to the same or an explicitly allowed earlier point-in-time information set.
object_types.unknown_semantics: Undefined arithmetic, insufficient history or failed quality returns UNKNOWN.

object_types.definition: A bounded estimate of background, phase and observable state axes, with uncertainty.
object_types.clock_rule: Lower-timeframe inputs cannot rewrite a higher-timeframe closed-bar state.
object_types.unknown_semantics: Insufficient or conflicting eligible evidence produces UNKNOWN or ABSTAIN.

object_types.definition: The current price location relative to versioned support, resistance, balance and event zones.
object_types.clock_rule: Zone construction and strength use only evidence available before the position is evaluated.
object_types.unknown_semantics: No valid interval or invalid width returns NO_VALID_ZONE.

object_types.definition: A non-exclusive explanation candidate such as covering, absorption, deleveraging or event repricing.
object_types.clock_rule: Mechanism detection ends before its outcome window.
object_types.unknown_semantics: Invalid evidence makes the mechanism untestable, not false.

object_types.definition: A versioned, finite and time-bounded future state or price path candidate.
object_types.clock_rule: The hypothesis text, window and falsifier freeze before its outcome begins.
object_types.unknown_semantics: The active set includes OTHER_PATH and UNKNOWN_PATH.

object_types.definition: A distribution over frozen, observable, mutually exclusive outcome labels.
object_types.clock_rule: Mapping and calibration are frozen before an evaluation window is opened.
object_types.unknown_semantics: Before out-of-sample calibration, values are ordinal and must not be named probabilities.

object_types.definition: A path, location, trigger, invalidation, horizon and cost-aware action candidate.
object_types.clock_rule: All components freeze before order submission.
object_types.unknown_semantics: Any missing mandatory component produces NO_TRADE_THESIS.

object_types.definition: A cost, fill and risk-aware estimate for a specific action conditional on a trade thesis.
object_types.clock_rule: Costs and fill estimates use only prior or contemporaneously available information.
object_types.unknown_semantics: Uncalibrated probabilities produce ordinal or bounded utility, not a precise EV.

object_types.definition: A separately governed decision that all data, state, risk, account and stage requirements permit an action.
object_types.clock_rule: Permission must be current at action time and cannot be supplied by the action candidate.
object_types.unknown_semantics: Unknown authority, data or risk yields DENY or UNKNOWN, never ALLOW.

object_types.definition: WAIT, WATCH, PREPARE, EXECUTE, MANAGE, EXIT or SUSPEND bound to a valid permission.
object_types.clock_rule: An action expires with its permission and cannot precede it.
object_types.unknown_semantics: Unknown maps to WAIT or SUSPEND.

object_types.definition: Immutable market-path, decision, risk and execution outcomes linked to their frozen candidate.
object_types.clock_rule: Results are recorded after the outcome window and cannot alter the original inputs.
object_types.unknown_semantics: Gaps or ambiguous first-hit ordering produce censored or inconclusive results.

object_types.definition: A typed support, contradiction, hard falsifier or data-quality observation linked to one dependency group.
object_types.clock_rule: available_at must precede the hypothesis update.
object_types.unknown_semantics: Invalid or expired evidence contributes no support and remains logged.

object_types.definition: An immutable record of how eligible evidence changed a state or hypothesis version.
object_types.clock_rule: The receipt is created before any downstream scenario, utility, permission or action consumes the update.
object_types.unknown_semantics: Rejected evidence remains visible with a reason code.

object_types.definition: Independent integrity, coverage, revision, PIT and mapping status.
object_types.clock_rule: Quality status is itself versioned and available no earlier than its proof.
object_types.unknown_semantics: UNKNOWN on any required axis prevents silent admission.

object_types.definition: A versioned mapping of timeframe role, close time, publication delay, freshness and downward propagation.
object_types.clock_rule: No unfinished bar is represented as a closed higher-timeframe fact.
object_types.unknown_semantics: Stale or unsynchronized context becomes UNKNOWN.

object_types.definition: A retained conflict between sources, definitions, methods or results.
object_types.clock_rule: Disputes are append-only and resolutions create new versions.
object_types.unknown_semantics: Unresolved disputes cannot be silently merged.

Direction and price-structure axis.
Leverage, open-interest and crowding axis.
Trade or order-flow pressure axis.

claims.claim_text: Fact, measurement, state, mechanism, path, trade thesis, utility, permission, action and result are distinct objects.
claims.falsifier: A formal dependency proof showing separation makes the target decision impossible without adding safety or audit value.

claims.claim_text: A historical decision may consume only a version whose available_at is not later than decision_at.
claims.falsifier: None within causal historical replay; changing it changes the research question to hindsight description.

claims.claim_text: Revised values create new versions and do not overwrite the historical information set.
claims.falsifier: An authoritative proof that the selected source and field never revise.
claims.limitations: Non-revising proof is source- and period-specific.

claims.claim_text: An ordinal evidence score is not a probability until calibrated on frozen out-of-sample outcomes.
claims.falsifier: A valid calibration mapping and independent reliability evidence for the exact score version.

claims.claim_text: Lower-timeframe triggers should not rewrite a closed higher-timeframe background state.
claims.falsifier: A preregistered simpler cross-timeframe alternative produces superior stable out-of-sample decisions without added leakage.
claims.limitations: Timeframe profile is not a universal market fact.

claims.claim_text: State-conditional RSI features may add decision value beyond structure and position, while RSI alone does not grant permission.
claims.scope: Target instruments and frozen horizons only
claims.falsifier: Qualified out-of-sample ablation shows no stable incremental value after costs and multiplicity control.
claims.limitations: May be redundant with price momentum.

claims.claim_text: Volatility-scaled structural intervals are more stable than exact support or resistance points.
claims.falsifier: Exact-point or simpler baseline is at least as stable and useful across preregistered states.
claims.limitations: Zone strength and consumption require separate contracts.

claims.claim_text: Order-flow imbalance and depth may explain short-horizon price impact, subject to target-market transport validation.
claims.scope: Literature sample only until target data test
claims.falsifier: Qualified target-market test shows no stable relation or no incremental value over simpler pressure measures.
claims.limitations: Equity-market literature does not establish crypto alpha.

claims.claim_text: Post-impact resilience can help distinguish absorption from continuation when measured in a non-overlapping sequenced window.
claims.scope: Strict L2 or otherwise adequate sequential observations
claims.falsifier: Qualified sequential test shows no stable discriminating value versus pressure-only controls.
claims.limitations: Aggregated depth snapshots do not establish order survival or replenishment.

claims.claim_text: A finite competing-path set with OTHER and UNKNOWN may improve error detection versus a single narrative.
claims.falsifier: Same-information single-path baseline is equally or more calibrated, useful and simple.

claims.claim_text: Dependency-group-aware evidence aggregation may reduce overconfidence from correlated indicators.
claims.falsifier: Independent test shows no calibration benefit or material loss of useful information.
claims.limitations: Dependency groups and aggregation rule are themselves hypotheses.

claims.claim_text: Calibrated probabilistic forecasts should be evaluated with proper scoring rules on observable mutually exclusive outcomes.
claims.falsifier: Not applicable to non-probabilistic mechanism support; misuse invalidates the evaluation.
claims.limitations: Proper score alone does not measure trading utility.

claims.claim_text: Repeated model selection on the same outcomes creates data-snooping and overfitting risk.
claims.falsifier: A proof that the candidate was fixed independently of the evaluation outcomes.
claims.limitations: No single correction removes all selection bias.

claims.claim_text: Market-path quality, fill probability, cost and execution risk must be evaluated separately.
claims.falsifier: A zero-cost perfectly liquid synthetic environment, which is not a live-market claim.
claims.limitations: Specific impact models require target-venue calibration.

claims.claim_text: Macro research must use the version and release time available at the historical decision.
claims.falsifier: An authoritative non-revising source with exact publication timestamps for the selected field.
claims.limitations: Vintage date can still differ from intraday release time.

claims.claim_text: Aggregate open interest change does not uniquely identify participant direction or opening and closing intent.
claims.falsifier: Participant-level authoritative records for the exact observation.
claims.limitations: OI can still be a useful contextual measurement.

claims.claim_text: Public aggregate price and volume cannot identify exact actors, participant counts or planned news releases.
claims.falsifier: Legally obtained participant-level authoritative records for the exact event.
claims.limitations: Observable pressure and response proxies remain testable.

claims.claim_text: Official documentation and literature establish semantics or prior research, not target-strategy market validity.
claims.falsifier: A separately qualified empirical target-market evaluation.
claims.limitations: Such evaluation supports only its exact candidate and scope.
